slingshot_memory.content: NutriChef AI backend is built using Python 3.11, FastAPI, MongoDB Atlas, and Beanie ODM.
The project follows a layered architecture with separate API, service, model, schema, and prompt builder modules.
Business logic should remain inside the service layer, while API routers should only handle requests and responses.
All AI-powered features reuse the shared AIProvider for model interactions.
Each AI feature should include a prompt builder, service, API, schema, and corresponding unit tests.
Pydantic v2 conventions and model_validate() should be used throughout the project.
FastAPI endpoints should use async functions, descriptive docstrings, response models, and proper HTTP status codes.
MongoDB collections are managed using Beanie document models and initialized during application startup.
All AI responses should be validated before being converted into response schemas.
Pytest with monkeypatch and AsyncClient is used for backend testing.
Prompt builders should return structured prompts that instruct the AI to generate valid JSON responses only.
Maintain consistent naming conventions and coding style across all backend modules.
